newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Palawan, PRCI modify equity swap.
newsitem.headline: Palawan, PRCI modify equity swap.

text.p: Philippine Racing Club Inc said on Monday its board had approved a modified property for equity swap entered into with several companies led by Palawan Consolidated Mining Co.
Corporate secretary Ferdinand Domingo told the Philippine Stock Exchange that the value of PRCI's two properties had been raised to 7.3 billion pesos from the previous 6.85 billion pesos.
The Palawan-led consortium had also agreed to swap a 2.389 billion peso lot of Sta. Lucia Realty & Development Inc and a 636 million peso lot of Central Vegetable Oil and Manufacturing Co.
The two real estate properties are on top of the shares of Ebecom Holdings, the majority owner of Palawan Consolidated worth 18 pesos each, which would be exchanged as part of the swap deal.
